newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SOCIETE GENERALE CZECH UNIT SEES 96 NET PROFIT UP. [CORRECTED 13:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SOCIETE GENERALE CZECH UNIT SEES 96 NET PROFIT UP. [CORRECTED 13:50 GMT]

text.p: The Czech unit of French (Corrects from Belgian) bank Societe Generale SA posted a net profit of 347 million crowns in 1996, a 48 percent increase over the previous year, the firm said in a preliminary report on Tuesday.
Societe Generale Banka a.s., established in 1991, said in a statement shareholder equity in the bank rose by "more than 30 percent to 1.627 billion" compared to the previous the year.
It added the bank's total assets at the end of 1996 were 30.4 billion crowns.
The statement added that all results were still to be approved by an auditor.
Societe Generale Banka, which operates under a universal banking licence, has branches in the three largest Czech cities -- Prague, Brno and Ostrava.
